title: SOVEREIGN AT THE THRESHOLD — house master of the founder's Gemini strike

provenance.engine: Gemini (Lyria), struck by the founder himself
provenance.prompt: the desk's filed 49-bar brief — studio-runs/gemini-49-bars/prompt.txt (pushed faf3a3b): exactly 49 bars, intro 3 / Verse I 20 / refrain 3 / Verse II 20 / outro 3; Detroit bounce, F minor; solfeggio arpeggio inside the performance; Sigma pair sweeping 13-31 Hz in the pocket
provenance.struck: 2026-11-10, uploaded by the founder the same day
provenance.ruling: adoption, 2026-11-10 — Gemini strikes; the desk measures, masters, notates, records
provenance.audio_custody: local only — rented-engine reference audio does not enter git (house rule)

width.reason: no stems exist; the vocal rides the mid and bleeds into what side signal there is, so any widening available to this desk would move the vocal image with the bed. The conservative correction cannot be shown to leave the vocal untouched — the doubt is real, so width is left as struck, confessed.

sigma.reason: whether Sigma rides a Gemini strike is the founder's open call, not the desk's; no layer was presumed. What the strike itself carries is weighed by both probes in analysis-stats.json (sigma_probe at the doctrine seats; sigma_sweep_probe for the ordered 13-31 Hz sweep).

notes: loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the house scales, stated not hidden).

the ceiling is law: had the true-peak trim taken the master below the loudness target, master.ceiling_overrode_loudness would say so in the open; the master block carries the gain, the trim and the flag as struck, and this prose adds nothing to them.
no head or tail fades: those belong to the performance chain's assembly of takes; an intake master of a finished render leaves the waveform's edges as struck.
nothing rides and nothing was removed: no Sigma, no EQ, no width process, no edit of any kind between decode and the loudness/ceiling law.
